note: Bodies are the `body` value of Tank01's {statusCode, body} envelope, byte-shaped as the API returns it: every value a string except where noted. Written from published captures and the RapidAPI schema, NOT recorded from the live API, because Plan A is built before a key exists. `npm run stats:tank01:record` rewrites every file here from the live API and flips provenance to recorded-from-live-api. The adapter's tests must pass unchanged across that flip; if they do not, the fixtures were wrong and the flip is what caught it.

entries.trimmedNote: The live response is 4,500+ players and about 5.5 MB. Trimmed to 24 players spanning QB/RB/WR/TE/K plus two unscored positions, keeping every field the mapper reads.

The live response is 521 entries. Trimmed to 13 exercising every shape a live capture (2026-08-25) showed: ordinary players with string overallADP values; DST entries that carry teamAbv/teamID and NO playerID at all (the id is minted the same way mapTeamsToDefensePlayers mints it); one deep entry with an EMPTY playerID and no team (2 of 521 in the capture, dropped); and one entry for an unscored-position player (10024, LB) that listPlayers never mints, proving the listed-players intersection.
Two games rather than a full week, so the box-score fixtures stay to two.
entries.note: Three entries, each proving one gameStatus mapping: SF@SEA carries "Completed" (-> final), CAR@WSH carries "Live - In Progress" (-> in_progress), and KC@BUF carries "Weather Delay", a spelling the vocabulary does not know, to prove the unrecognized-status default (-> in_progress) against a real listGames payload rather than only against a synthetic one in map.test.ts.

entries.trimmedNote: Seven players spanning every stat group, plus both DST sides. The seventh, 10024, is an unscored position (LB) with tackle stats — playerStats carries every player who appeared regardless of position, so this is what a real box score's unscored entries look like, and it is the fixture the adapter's listed-players filter is proven against.
Same shape, different teams, one player with no stat groups at all, one with negative rushing yardage (10008, a real NFL occurrence the adapter must not clamp to zero).

entries.note: Empty playerStats and DST: a weather-delayed game has no plays yet. Added so the shared StatsProvider contract suite's per-game cases (which call getGameStatLines on every game listGames(1) returns, including this one) can exercise the Tank01 provider over KC@BUF without a live request; mapBoxScoreToStatLines correctly answers no stat lines for it.

entries.trimmedNote: Two games rather than a full week; only the week's existence is under assertion here.
entries.note: The LAST week of the regular season (TANK01_CONFIG.weeks.last). The shared StatsProvider contract suite asserts that a provider's declared lastWeekOfSeason is a week it actually answers with games — a provider that overshoots by even one week leaves the ingestion worker's pointer stalled on a week that can never get a stat_weeks row, which is the exact failure a pipeline-level constant of 18 caused against the 17-week mock dataset.
An out-of-range week. Kept to document what upstream does, even though the adapter answers this locally and never sends it.
